title: Build an ActiveMQ backlog and recovery envelope
description: Choose a workload, then change arrival rate, consumer count, durable share, and interruption length. The model uses measured handler rates instead of claiming a universal broker benchmark.

profiles.label: Order commands
profiles.detail: Moderate payloads with database writes, idempotency checks, and a strong durability requirement.

profiles.label: Telemetry bridge
profiles.detail: Small measurements with inexpensive handlers and a mixed durability policy.

profiles.label: Document jobs
profiles.detail: Larger commands whose consumers perform slower object-store and document-processing work.
